description: The District Office Field Representative/Caseworker monitors and updates the Congressman and District Director on district and local issues. description: The Committee on Ethics seeks an experienced attorney for an Investigative Counsel position. The Committee's investigative counsels are responsible for conducting investigations and adjudicatory and disciplinary proceedings regarding Members and staff of the U.S. House of Representatives. This is a nonpartisan position which requires the ability to conduct impartial investigations and refrain from political or partisan activity. Candidates must possess outstanding analytical and written/oral communications skills, as well as the sound judgment necessary to evaluate the sensitive matters that arise before the Committee. Experience in one or more of the following areas is desirable: government ethics, criminal law, civil litigation, administrative investigations and adjudications, depositions, and financial accounting. Salary commensurate with experience. Please email resume, cover letter, and short writing sample to ethicsjobs@mail.house.gov. Please include the phrase "Investigative Counsel" in the subject line.
responsibilities: Conducting investigations regarding Members and staff of the U.S. House of Representatives
Conducting adjudicatory and disciplinary proceedings regarding Members and staff of the U.S. House of Representatives
Conducting impartial investigations in a nonpartisan manner
Refraining from political or partisan activity
qualifications: Experienced attorney
Outstanding analytical skills
Outstanding written and oral communications skills
Sound judgment necessary to evaluate sensitive matters
Experience in government ethics (desirable)
Experience in criminal law (desirable)
Experience in civil litigation (desirable)
Experience in administrative investigations and adjudications (desirable)
Experience in depositions (desirable)
Experience in financial accounting (desirable)
how_to_apply: Email resume, cover letter, and short writing sample to ethicsjobs@mail.house.gov. Include the phrase "Investigative Counsel" in the subject line.

description: The Office of Congressman Juan Vargas is seeking a high energy, highly organized, and detail oriented Field Representative/Caseworker for his District Office. Primary responsibilities include serving as an official representative for the Member throughout communities in the District, acting as liaison with federal, district, and local government agencies, monitoring district and local issues, staffing district meetings and events, assessing casework issues for possible legislative action, answering casework correspondence, and providing casework assistance to constituents. Qualifications include a background in military/veteran issues, ability to work non-traditional hours, excellent written and interpersonal communication skills in English and Spanish, understanding of the federal legislative process, U.S. citizenship, and a valid California driver's license. To apply, email a resume and cover letter to CAJobs@mail.house.gov.

Excellent written (English and Spanish) and interpersonal communication skills.
Ability to work with staff at all levels, work well under pressure and be detail oriented.
Possess an understanding of the federal legislative process.
Ability to quickly learn about key issues and events in the district for which the Member is involved.
